note: Both sets extract the same core facts correctly — the reference keynote codes (BOOSTER PUMP 22 11 23, DOMESTIC WATER PIPING 22 11 16, HTP SUPERSTOR SOLAR WATER TANK 22 33 00, SOLAR PUMP STATION 23 56 01, DISHWASHER 11 31 13.A7), the C1 drawing scale 1/2"=1'-0", and the ground-plane elevations — and both share the same defects: four invented 'location' claims (lower right / upper vertical / central / lower left assembly) that the page never states, several vague 'system'/'plumbing system' component-identifier claims, and repeated facts (CEILING FINISH elevation stated twice, keynote codes stated again under generic names). Set A adds one further redundant, vague claim ('floor | finish height | 2'-0 3/8"') that merely repeats the Finish Floor elevation, so B is the cleaner set. Both sets also omit the General Sheet Notes (waste pipe slope min 1/4 in/ft per 2009 IRC, all supply and waste pipe to be PVC, cable/hose carrier details on XE-001) and the A1 waste section scale.
remarks: The four 'location' claims (e.g. 'component 22 33 00 | location | lower right assembly') have no textual support anywhere on the page and use an undefined 'assembly' vocabulary; they should be dropped or replaced by verifiable section/detail references. The generic entities ('system', 'plumbing system', 'Water Supply System') are misbound or vague: 22 11 23.A2 is SUMP PUMP and 22 41 23.B3 is PRE-FABRICATED SHOWER STALL per the Reference Keynotes, so binding them to 'Water Supply System'/'plumbing system' is wrong. Elevation values are given as feet-inches (e.g. 2'-0 3/8") but tagged with unit 'ft', which double-states the unit. Both sets miss the three General Sheet Notes and the named keynotes CLOTHES WASHER, SUMP PUMP, PRE-FABRICATED SHOWER STALL, FACILITY SANITARY SEWERAGE and the A1 (WASTE WATER LONGITUDINAL SECTION) scale.
